title: Learning Fair Representation via Distributional Contrastive Disentanglement

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating fair classification by measuring the accuracy of predicting the sensitive attribute (gender) versus the target label on tabular datasets (Adult, German). Additionally, evaluating text embeddings using the Sentence Encoder Association Test (SEAT) to measure effect sizes between gender-related words and stereotyped concepts (e.g., Career/Family, Math/Arts, Science/Arts).

Measuring out-of-distribution domain generalization and invariant representation learning by evaluating classification accuracy when non-semantic spurious features (e.g., lighting conditions in YaleB, digit colors in cMNIST, image backgrounds in Waterbirds) are shifted or reversed in the test set.
